MEMBERSHIP_PROGRAM.expr: 'Moxie Memberships (launched Feb 2026)' if r['PRACTICE_NAME'] in ('Lumiere Aesthetics', 'Brickell Skin Bar', 'GoodJuju Medspa', 'Harbor Glow Medspa', 'Peachtree Skin Society', 'Mile High Medspa', 'Skinique Aesthetics', 'Uptown Glow Lab') else 'Packages Only'

columns.name: SERVICE_CATEGORY
columns.expr: weighted({'Facials & Skin': 58, 'Laser & IPL': 30 * (1.35 if month in (11, 12, 1, 2) else 0.65 if month in (6, 7, 8) else 1), 'Microneedling & PRP': 12}) if r['PROVIDER_ROLE'] == 'Licensed Aesthetician' else weighted({'Neurotoxin': 36, 'Dermal Filler': 17 * (1.15 if month in (10, 11, 12) else 1), 'Laser & IPL': 7 * (1.35 if month in (11, 12, 1, 2) else 0.65 if month in (6, 7, 8) else 1), 'Facials & Skin': 6, 'Microneedling & PRP': 8, 'Weight Loss (GLP-1)': 14 * (1.3 if month == 1 else 1), 'Body Contouring': 8 * (1.25 if month in (3, 4, 5) else 1)})

columns.name: PRODUCT_BRAND
columns.expr: weighted({'Botox': 44, 'Dysport': 26, 'Xeomin': 12, 'Daxxify': 9, 'Jeuveau': 9}) if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] == 'Neurotoxin' else ('Sculptra' if 'Sculptra' in r['SERVICE_NAME'] else weighted({'Juvederm': 44, 'Restylane': 34, 'RHA Collection': 22})) if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] == 'Dermal Filler' else {'Semaglutide Monthly': 'Semaglutide (compounded)', 'Tirzepatide Monthly': 'Tirzepatide (compounded)', 'CoolSculpting': 'CoolSculpting', 'Emsculpt NEO': 'Emsculpt NEO', 'Kybella': 'Kybella', 'HydraFacial': 'HydraFacial', 'RF Microneedling (Morpheus8)': 'Morpheus8', 'Microneedling with PRP': 'SkinPen', 'IPL Photofacial': 'Lumenis IPL', 'Fractional Laser Resurfacing': 'Halo by Sciton'}.get(r['SERVICE_NAME'], 'House Protocol')

columns.name: PATIENT_TYPE
columns.expr: weighted({'New Patient': 23, 'Returning Patient': 77})

columns.name: PATIENT_NAME
columns.expr: pick(['Ava','Mia','Sophia','Emma','Olivia','Isabella','Harper','Chloe','Madison','Ella','Grace','Lily','Zoe','Nora','Riley','Layla','Aubrey','Hannah','Brooke','Kayla','Jenna','Taylor','Morgan','Lauren','Ashley','Megan','Rachel','Nicole','Dana','Priya','Camila','Valeria','Elena','Gabriela','Jasmine','Tiffany','Kristen','Amanda','Jessica','Sarah','Michael','David','Chris','Ryan','James','Marcus','Daniel','Kevin']) + ' ' + pick(['A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H','J','K','L','M','N','P','R','S','T','V','W']) + '.'

columns.name: PATIENT_ID
columns.expr: 'PT-' + str(rng.randint(100000, 999999))

columns.name: MEMBERSHIP_STATUS
columns.expr: 'Non-member' if r['PATIENT_TYPE'] == 'New Patient' and chance(0.9) else weighted({'Non-member': 1 - (0.13 + 0.27 * ramp(250) if r['MEMBERSHIP_PROGRAM'].startswith('Moxie') else 0.12), 'Glow Member': 0.55 * (0.13 + 0.27 * ramp(250) if r['MEMBERSHIP_PROGRAM'].startswith('Moxie') else 0.12), 'Radiance Member': 0.33 * (0.13 + 0.27 * ramp(250) if r['MEMBERSHIP_PROGRAM'].startswith('Moxie') else 0.12), 'VIP Member': 0.12 * (0.13 + 0.27 * ramp(250) if r['MEMBERSHIP_PROGRAM'].startswith('Moxie') else 0.12)})

columns.name: BOOKING_CHANNEL
columns.expr: weighted({'Online Booking': 44, 'Phone': 20 - 8 * ramp(365), 'In-Clinic Rebook': 22, 'MAIA AI Assistant': 3 + 10 * ramp(365), 'Walk-in': 5})

columns.name: MARKETING_SOURCE
columns.expr: 'Returning Patient' if r['PATIENT_TYPE'] == 'Returning Patient' else weighted({'Instagram': 30, 'Google Search': 24, 'Patient Referral': 20, 'TikTok': 11, 'Promo / Groupon': 7, 'Community Event': 8})

columns.name: APPOINTMENT_STATUS
columns.expr: weighted({'Completed': 87.5, 'Cancelled': 7, 'No-show': 5.5 * (0.6 if r['MEMBERSHIP_STATUS'] != 'Non-member' else 1)})

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD
columns.expr: None if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] != 'Completed' else weighted({'Membership Wallet': 55, 'Credit Card': 35, 'Package Credit': 10}) if r['MEMBERSHIP_STATUS'] != 'Non-member' else weighted({'Credit Card': 70, 'Patient Financing (Cherry)': 9, 'Package Credit': 9, 'Gift Card': 5, 'HSA / FSA': 4, 'Cash': 3})

columns.name: UNITS_USED
columns.expr: max(8, int(lognorm(30, 0.38) * (1.15 if r['MEMBERSHIP_STATUS'] != 'Non-member' else 1))) if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] == 'Neurotoxin' else weighted({1: 62, 2: 30, 3: 8}) if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] == 'Dermal Filler' else weighted({1: 70, 2: 22, 3: 8}) if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] in ('Body Contouring', 'Laser & IPL') else 1

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.expr: (lognorm({'Neurotoxin': 14.5, 'Dermal Filler': 735, 'Laser & IPL': 380, 'Facials & Skin': 195, 'Microneedling & PRP': 640, 'Weight Loss (GLP-1)': 449, 'Body Contouring': 820}[r['SERVICE_CATEGORY']], 0.12) * (1.18 if r['LOCATION_STATE'] in ('California', 'New York') else 1.0))

columns.name: GROSS_REVENUE
columns.expr: r['UNITS_USED'] * r['UNIT_PRICE'] if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] == 'Completed' else 0.0

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.expr: r['GROSS_REVENUE'] * (uniform(0.10, 0.16) if r['MEMBERSHIP_STATUS'] != 'Non-member' else 0.2 if r['MARKETING_SOURCE'] == 'Promo / Groupon' else (uniform(0.05, 0.1) if chance(0.12) else 0))

columns.name: NET_REVENUE
columns.expr: r['GROSS_REVENUE'] - r['DISCOUNT_AMOUNT']

columns.name: PRODUCT_COST
columns.expr: r['GROSS_REVENUE'] * {'Neurotoxin': 0.44, 'Dermal Filler': 0.37, 'Laser & IPL': 0.12, 'Facials & Skin': 0.18, 'Microneedling & PRP': 0.16, 'Weight Loss (GLP-1)': 0.34, 'Body Contouring': 0.22}[r['SERVICE_CATEGORY']] * uniform(0.9, 1.1)

columns.name: GROSS_MARGIN
columns.expr: r['NET_REVENUE'] - r['PRODUCT_COST']

columns.name: NO_SHOW_FEE
columns.expr: 50.0 if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] == 'No-show' and chance(0.65) else 0.0

columns.name: TIP_AMOUNT
columns.expr: r['NET_REVENUE'] * uniform(0.08, 0.2) if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] == 'Completed' and r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] in ('Facials & Skin', 'Laser & IPL', 'Microneedling & PRP') and chance(0.55) else 0.0

columns.name: APPOINTMENT_MINUTES
columns.expr: {'Neurotoxin': 30, 'Dermal Filler': 45, 'Laser & IPL': 45, 'Facials & Skin': 60, 'Microneedling & PRP': 60, 'Weight Loss (GLP-1)': 15, 'Body Contouring': 60}[r['SERVICE_CATEGORY']] + 15 * (r['UNITS_USED'] - 1 if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] in ('Dermal Filler', 'Body Contouring') else 0) + (15 if r['PATIENT_TYPE'] == 'New Patient' else 0)

columns.name: REBOOKED_FLAG
columns.expr: 0 if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] != 'Completed' else (1 if chance(min(0.95, (0.56 + (0.06 if r['SERVICE_CATEGORY'] in ('Neurotoxin', 'Weight Loss (GLP-1)') else 0) + (0.17 if r['MEMBERSHIP_STATUS'] != 'Non-member' else 0) - (0.08 if r['PATIENT_TYPE'] == 'New Patient' else 0)) * (1.22 - 0.6 * ramp(150) if r['PROVIDER_NAME'] == 'Zara Hughes, NP' else 1))) else 0)

columns.name: COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] == 'Completed' else 0

columns.name: NO_SHOW_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if r['APPOINTMENT_STATUS'] == 'No-show' else 0

columns.name: MEMBER_FLAG
columns.expr: 0 if r['MEMBERSHIP_STATUS'] == 'Non-member' else 1

columns.name: NEW_PATIENT_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if r['PATIENT_TYPE'] == 'New Patient' else 0

post.name: RECALL_ID
post.expr: r['RECALL_ID'] if r['FOLLOW_UP_STATUS'] != 'No Follow-up' else None

post.name: DAYS_SINCE_VISIT
post.expr: age if r['FOLLOW_UP_STATUS'] in ('Due for Recall', 'Overdue', 'Recall Sent') else None
